integrity_statement: A self-contained analytic argument is supplied; finite computations are identified as diagnostics. No claim of independent validation or established publication priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar multipliers of the Drury–Arveson reproducing-kernel space, with zero constant coefficient, are classified.
The first-order radial majorant expansion is local to the critical radius; the full radial majorant profile is not determined.
The finite checker is diagnostic and does not prove the statement in arbitrary dimension.
Full text of two plausible priority sources was not available for detailed comparison; equivalent earlier coverage cannot be excluded.
title: The sharp zero-centered Bohr ball for Drury–Arveson multipliers
